outcome: Duration of 1st and 2nd stage of labor
cohort: 1052 parturients (443 with EA and 609 without) aged 18-40 with singleton pregnancies and cephalic presentation of the fetus who gave live birth at a gestational age of 37-42 weeks to neonates with birthweight 2500-4250 g at St. Sophia's Specialist Hospital in Warsaw, between 1/1/2020 and 6/1/2020
finding: Epidural analgesia was associated with longer labor duration, both in the first and second stages, but a lower risk of emergency Cesarean sections.
mod_finding: The risk of emergency CS in nulliparas with EA is three times lower.
